chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 — No Stimulus (3 points) — Set 2: European unification
chunks.content: AP European History SAQ 4 (No Stimulus), 3 points, one per part. Set 2 prompts: A [1] describe one significant political characteristic of European unification efforts; B [1] describe one economic factor that facilitated European unification efforts; C [1] explain one way the economic system in Eastern Europe differed from that in another region. 'Describe' = relevant characteristics; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: A naming an event without a political characteristic; C stating a difference without explaining it.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 4A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 4 (Set 2) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Described a political characteristic of unification efforts, an economic facilitating factor, and explained an Eastern-European economic difference. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 4B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 4 (Set 2) scored 2/3 (A 0, B 1, C 1). Earned B (an economic facilitating factor) and C (an explained economic difference) but lost A (no valid political characteristic of unification efforts). Illustrates missing the first Describe part while completing the factor and explanation.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 4C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 4 (Set 2) scored 1/3 (A 0, B 0, C 1). Earned only C (explained an Eastern-European economic difference). Lost A (no valid political characteristic) and B (no valid economic factor). Illustrates a response that can explain a regional difference but not describe unification's political characteristic or economic driver.
